schema.title: Role Matrix Lab Combinator Master
schema.description: Instance data for the role-grant combinator cases of role-matrix-lab (vnext feature/role-grant-combinators). iban: anyOf[$InstanceStarter, $InstanceBehalfOfStarter] OR corporate-ops, masked except for corporate-ops. riskNote: corporate-ops allowed unless the same caller is also the behalf-of starter (deny allOf). hiddenFromAll: deny $Everyone, hidden from every caller (vnext#1193). hiddenByWorkaround: the older [deny $InstanceStarter, allow $InstanceStarter] pair, also hidden from every caller.

customerId.description: Unguarded. The customer the case is about (the plan's VELİ).

iban.description: x-roles combinator: the starter (act_sub) or the behalf-of starter (sub), or corporate-ops. Masked for everyone but corporate-ops.

riskNote.description: x-roles four-eyes on data: corporate-ops sees it unless the same caller is the behalf-of starter of the case.

hiddenFromAll.description: x-roles deny $Everyone: stored, but pruned for every caller on every read surface (vnext#1193).

hiddenByWorkaround.description: The pre-$Everyone workaround: deny $InstanceStarter hides it from the starter, the lone allow $InstanceStarter makes it an allowlist that admits nobody else.
